title: Gemma Translator: a two-way voice translator on a Raspberry Pi 5

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Gemma translator is a two-way voice translator that runs entirely on a Raspberry Pi 5 with no internet after setup. Two lanes face each other on a small kiosk screen, each with a rotating language selector. Hold a key, speak, and the other side hears it back in their language.
